_comment: Raft-only high-concurrency scaling follow-up. The recorded scaling
family is fixed at concurrency 32 and the recorded concurrency family
is fixed at 3 replicas, so neither covers the concurrency x replica
interaction. This family tests whether the replica-scaling penalty
observed at c32 persists under higher offered concurrency (c128, c256).
Raft only, 100% writes, 5 repetitions per cell. The runner's default
minimum is 10 repetitions, so this config must be run with the explicit
4 replica counts x 2 concurrency levels x 5 repetitions = 40 runs.
The `defaults` block is a verbatim copy of configs/matrix.json's
defaults (same CPU/memory allocation, keyspace, timeouts, Raft
timeouts, seed, duration and warm-up), so the runs use the same
benchmark methodology as the recorded runs and differ only in the
